## Environment

- **Interface:** browser tab, installed app or companion (HTTP or MCP).
- **App version and build:** from About DonDocs; for companion reports, include its version or commit.
- **Browser and version:** if applicable.

- **Connection:** online or offline when the problem occurred.

## Supporting details

Include relevant error text or synthetic screenshots if useful. Review logs for
sensitive data before posting. Do not upload a real draft, backup or share link.

For marking-related problems, describe the configured and expected options using
synthetic, unclassified content. See the [classification guide](https://github.com/marinecoders/dondocs/blob/main/docs/CLASSIFICATION_CONFIG.md).
